bead.title: bench-pr-A3b: resume/skip terminal cells + --retry-invalid
bead.description:
PROBLEM: A re-invoked runner must not redo finished work, must honor --force-rerun, and must let an operator surface invalid or crashed cells via --retry-invalid. Without resume the canary cannot be safely re-run; without --retry-invalid orphaned (mid-run crash) and invalid-class cells are silently kept.

ROOT CAUSE:
- Resume coverage logic ported from cmd/bench/matrix.go: terminal-status gating at cmd/bench/matrix.go:1681 (graded_pass/graded_fail/install_fail_permanent/budget_halted) and the cell-discovery walk at cmd/bench/matrix.go:1576.
- Bash anchors: terminal-status predicate at scripts/benchmark/benchmark:895 (is_terminal_final_status) and the invalid/orphan detection that walks task_dir/*/ comparing report.json terminal status at scripts/benchmark/benchmark:1056-1070. The --force-rerun and --retry-invalid flags are parsed by A2 (scripts/benchmark/benchmark:294-298) and must now drive behavior.

PROPOSED FIX (scripts/benchmark/benchmark):
- Resume: if cell_dir/report.json exists with a terminal final_status, skip the cell. --force-rerun ignores existing reports and mints fresh reps.
- --retry-invalid: rerun cells whose report.json has a non-empty invalid_class OR whose cell-state.json is orphan (sentinel present, no terminal report.json = mid-run crash). The fresh cell links to the prior via attempt_of and the prior cell is back-written with superseded_by (the one permitted mutation of a closed cell — coordinate the link-writing helper shared with A3d; A3b owns invoking it for the invalid/orphan path).

NON-SCOPE: arg parsing / matrix / --plan (A2); adapters + image (A1); core per-cell loop + report.json composition (A3a, prerequisite); budget accounting + halt placeholders (A3c); per-cell transient retry backoff (A3d); flock/setsid/job-pool concurrency and SIGINT/SIGTERM handling (A4); Go agent-leak fix, Go deactivation, parity (A5). Parent out-of-scope preserved: PR B schema; PR C bench-set schema; PR D collector; PR E importers; PR F deleting cmd/bench; PR G docs. Governing artifact: docs/helix/02-design/plan-2026-05-15-benchmark-runner-simplification.md.

DEPENDS ON: A3a (and transitively A2, A1). BLOCKS: A4.

ACCEPTANCE (satisfies parent A3 AC2):
1. Re-running ./scripts/benchmark/benchmark --profile sindri-lucebox --bench-set tb-2-1-canary without --force-rerun skips cells whose report.json has a terminal final_status; --force-rerun re-runs them. TestResumeAndRetryInvalid (cmd/bench/runner_a3_test.go); bats Test_resume_skips_terminal_cell (scripts/benchmark/tests/runner.bats).
2. --retry-invalid reruns cells with non-empty invalid_class OR an orphan cell-state.json, linking the new cell via attempt_of and back-writing superseded_by into the prior cell. TestResumeAndRetryInvalid; bats Test_retry_invalid_reruns (scripts/benchmark/tests/runner.bats).
GATES: bats scripts/benchmark/test (and scripts/benchmark/tests/runner.bats) pass; `go test ./...` passes; `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
